title: How One End-of-Day Ritual Keeps a Godly Man's Work Honest
caption:
Godly work doesn't end at quitting time.

Colossians 3:23 doesn't just cover the 9 to 5. It covers how you close it out too.

Name what you actually finished. Close the loops you're tempted to carry into the night. Hand the day back to God before you hand it to a screen.

Win tomorrow tonight.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #discipline #work
